chunks.heading: Remote access
chunks.text: All employees must use multi-factor authentication when connecting to company systems remotely.

chunks.heading: Incident reporting
chunks.text: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the Security Operations team within one hour of discovery.

chunks.heading: Passwords
chunks.text: Company account passwords must contain at least 14 characters and must not be reused from personal accounts.

chunks.heading: Annual leave
chunks.text: Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid annual leave for each calendar year.

chunks.heading: Requesting leave
chunks.text: Employees should submit annual leave requests at least five business days before the first day away.

chunks.heading: Air travel
chunks.text: Employees must book economy class for flights shorter than six hours. Business class may be booked for flights of six hours or longer with manager approval.

chunks.heading: Booking
chunks.text: Company travel must be booked through the approved travel portal whenever available.

chunks.heading: Receipts
chunks.text: Itemized receipts are required for individual business expenses greater than 25 US dollars.

chunks.heading: Reimbursement
chunks.text: Employees must submit expense reports within 30 calendar days after the expense was incurred.

chunks.heading: Equipment stipend
chunks.text: Remote employees may claim up to 500 US dollars per calendar year for approved home office equipment.

chunks.heading: Work location
chunks.text: Employees working remotely must work from a country where the company is registered to employ staff.
